purpose: Estimate the Stage-6R matched-clean total-bit Pareto frontier under the primary fault condition after the full-protocol dry-run passed its scan-entry gate.

decision_rules.primary_success: At one or more matched clean targets of at least 0.90, paired total-bit savings has a 95 percent lower confidence bound above zero.
decision_rules.strong_effect: At a matched clean target of at least 0.90, mean total-bit savings is at least 15 percent.
decision_rules.high_reliability_support: At least one real non-interpolated semantic workpoint has a 95 percent clean lower bound of at least 0.95.
decision_rules.protocol_bottleneck: If high reliability is unavailable or savings collapses, decompose recovery-install, heartbeat, ACK, duplicate, compact, and escape bits before proposing a protocol change.

claim_boundary: This is a development-only matched-reliability scan, not external Final evidence.
The four activities and temporal gate were already used during development, so the scan cannot establish external generalization.
No temporal-gate threshold, selected action tuple, or codebook size may be retuned from this result.
Full codebook installation is conservatively counted after every independent activity calibration.
Only real simulated workpoints are eligible; curve interpolation is not used for success claims.
